card.name: Spatial extent between two endpoints
card.fires_on: Words in descriptions of spatial extent or direction between two places or body parts, such as 'from the Gulf of Mexico north to', 'between the shoulder and the elbow', or 'upper extremity'. It fires at the first endpoint, the linking word, or the direction word.

modes.label: Geographic spans
modes.description: Place names and directions in a stretch of land from one place to another.

modes.label: Anatomical ends and sites
modes.description: Upper or lower ends of an organ, or a site halfway between two body landmarks.

card.plain: It marks wording that describes a span running from one point to another, on a map or on the body.
